description: This file defines the ViewLocationController class for the OrangeHRM Admin plugin. It manages the pre-render setup for the location list view, including initializing a Vue component and setting permissions. It interacts with the CountryService to retrieve country data and prepares the view for rendering.

classes.name: ViewLocationController
classes.description: Controller handling the view location logic in OrangeHRM's admin plugin. Extends BaseAdminController and manages component creation and permissions related to locations.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component for the location list view, sets permissions, and binds country data to the component.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Returns data groups used to verify user capabilities, specifically for 'locations'.
